The first girl on the left, wearing a blue and white school uniform jacket, leaned slightly closer to the camera, her expression a mixture of concern and amusement, and said to the lens:"醒啦？你午睡睡了快两节课。再不醒，我们都准备给你送医院了。" | The camera shifts slightly to the left side of the frame, turning its gaze toward the second girl from the left—the one wearing a white shirt, a dark tie, and sporting long, straight black hair. She leans in slightly, looking into the camera with a mix of seriousness and bewilderment as she asks:"你做梦了吧？一直喊GPT、DeepSeek。你平时背ABC都费劲，梦里还挺国际化。" | The camera then naturally panned to the center, focusing on the girl in the middle wearing a pink hooded jacket and short hair. She leaned slightly closer to the desk, looking at the camera with a curious and disbelieving expression, and said:"你还说以后AI能写文章、画图、做视频。大哥！现在2016年，我们连流量都不敢随便开。"
 | The camera then slightly shifted to the right, where the girl on the right, wearing a beige knitted vest and a white shirt, leaned slightly closer, looking at the camera with a serious yet slightly doubtful expression, and said:"不过你刚才说那些，还挺像那么回事儿。咋滴？穿越啦？" | Finally, the camera slowly returned to the first girl on the left wearing a blue and white school uniform jacket. She leaned slightly closer again, while the other three girls remained around her, their expressions a mixture of curiosity and amusement. The first girl on the left laughed and said:"算了吧，别管什么鸡屁踢、鸭屁踢，下节数学课，作业做好了吗？" |
